introHtml: Zippered portfolios keep materials secure during travel and daily commutes. Unlike open-top options, the full zipper closure prevents papers, tablets, and accessories from falling out. This makes them a practical choice for sales teams, field representatives, and event attendees who need reliable organization. Decorate with debossed logos, foil stamping, or screen printing for a polished business look.
